# Step AB: rare parts load on first use

Lex (2026-11-16, Orbit TOOLS-311, pick 4 of the TOOLS-296 review): the parts of the editor a person uses rarely load the first time they are needed, the way the B-roll part does since step Z, so opening the editor downloads less. Nothing on screen changes. It waits with saving (step AA) for Lex's click-through before it goes live.

## What it does

- **The share room** (`public/together/room.js`, 35 KB) loads when the host first reaches Share to edit (the pointer over it, a press, or the keyboard focus on it, so the click seldom waits), or as soon as a guest's edit link opens (while the Join form shows). `together-adapter.js` loads it with `import()` and checks its seam version (`ROOM_SEAM` and `SEAM`).
  - The edit link is made and copied inside the Share to edit click, as before: its keys come from `public/together/link.js` (`newRoom`, `makeLink`, `parseLink`, the id and key rules), which loads at startup; `room.js` passes them on. The room with those keys starts once its part is here.
  - While the part is on its way, sharing counts as on (`together.sharing`: another script may not open over it, the agent's `open_script` is refused as before), while no room runs yet (`together.active`), so the person's own Undo still works; the app's Undo steps from before sharing end only when the room starts (`app.sharing(true)`). Stop sharing, or opening another script, drops it: no room starts and Undo keeps its steps. A guest's newer join replaces an older one still waiting.
  - A part that can't load (or speaks another seam version): the host's share ends (Undo keeps its steps) and the button's label and tooltip say "Couldn't share. Reload the page." (no new link is copied after that, and a later click says it again, also when the share that met the failure had been stopped); a guest's Join says "Couldn't load the edit link. Reload the page." where the ended-link note shows.
  - The rest of working together (the adapter, `ops.js`, carets, the share button) stays at startup: the agent's caret uses it even when nothing is shared.
- **The export pack** (`public/export-pack.js`, with `zip.js` and the video-folder writer `video-folder.js`, 14 KB in all) loads when the Export menu opens (`beforetoggle`, so a menu opened and closed at once still asks for it). Export all and Save to video folder use it; a click waits for it if it is not here yet. The folder picker still opens inside the click; everything a save or a zip needs is read (for a save, copied: the document, the shots and the sketches) from the script before the pack is awaited, so it is the script as it was at the click that is exported, whatever is typed or opened meanwhile.
  - Its interface: `SEAM`, `zipAll(files)` (Export all) and `saveFolder({ dir, doc, scriptText, title, broll, modified, dirty })` (the folder written to `dir`, or the zip of it without one).
  - The note under "Save to video folder" and what a save needs of the B-roll list (`listState`, `settleFolder`, `folderNote`) moved to `public/folder-note.js`, which loads at startup; `video-folder.js` passes them on.
  - A pack that can't load (or speaks another seam version): Export all and Save to video folder both say "Couldn't load. Reload the page." on the item (a new note under Export all, hidden otherwise) until a reload, and neither downloads or writes anything.
- Not moved: the agent link section of `app.js` (the review: it starts only once a token is stored, but it is woven through the asks, answers and the agent's script tools, and needs a step-Z-style move first).
- Cache and CSP (step Y): the new files are same-site module scripts (`script-src 'self'`) with `Cache-Control: no-cache` and an ETag; after a reload each answers 304.
- Sizes (the files the page needs before it runs, `index.html`'s module script and its static imports): before, 16 files and 468,623 bytes of JavaScript; now 15 files and 428,101 bytes (−40,522, −8.6 %). On first use: `together/room.js` 34,578, `export-pack.js` 1,696, `video-folder.js` 8,786, `zip.js` 3,123 bytes.

## Where

`public/together/link.js` (new), `public/together/room.js`, `public/together/share-button.js` (`fail(text)`; a copy that lands after sharing ended no longer says "Link copied"), `public/together-adapter.js` (`createTogether(app, { loadRoom })`, `preload()`), `public/export-pack.js` (new), `public/folder-note.js` (new), `public/video-folder.js`, `public/app.js` (the export pack's loader, Export all and Save to video folder, the guest's note, `together.preload()` for a guest's link), `public/index.html` (`#zipNote`). Tests: `tests/rare-parts.test.mjs`. Browser check: `scripts/smoke-rare-parts.mjs`.

## Browser check

`scripts/smoke-rare-parts.mjs` on `wrangler dev` (it applies `_headers` and runs the rooms) and headless Chrome, at 1280 and 390 px with real clicks, watching every request: a new script with typing fetches none of `together/room.js`, `export-pack.js`, `video-folder.js`, `zip.js` (and does fetch `together/link.js` and `folder-note.js`); opening the Export menu loads the pack, Export all downloads the script's zip (it starts with "PK") and no note shows; the pointer over Share to edit fetches `room.js` before any click (1280 px), Share to edit copies the edit link, loads `room.js`, and the room started is the one in the copied link, with "Link copied" and Stop sharing; the guest's link loads `room.js` while the Join form shows (and no export pack), the guest joins and gets the host's text, the host sees the guest; Stop sharing ends the room; after a reload each of the four files answers 304 on the wire; with `room.js` held, the link is still copied in the click, sharing shows as on with no room, Ctrl+Z undoes the person's typing, and Stop sharing before the part comes starts none and keeps the Undo steps from before the share; with `room.js` and `export-pack.js` refused, the share button says "Couldn't share. Reload the page." and sharing is off, Export all and Save to video folder say "Couldn't load. Reload the page." and Export all downloads nothing, and a guest's Join says "Couldn't load the edit link. Reload the page."; with `export-pack.js` held, Export all clicked and then another script opened downloads one zip, of the script of the click; a pack refused after the video folder was picked writes nothing to it and the item says to reload; a folder saved while the pack is held, with more typed meanwhile, holds the script as it was at the click in `script.md`, `prompter.md` and `recording-notes.md`. No CSP violation and no page error. The older suites run on the same server. Evidence: `docs/agents/evidence/tools-311-browser.txt`.

## Done

Feature list: no change (rare parts load on first use; nothing on screen changes)

### Proof

- Failing tests first: met. `tests/rare-parts.test.mjs` failed 8 of 9 on `origin/dev` (`together/room.js`, `zip.js` and `video-folder.js` among the startup files; no `export-pack.js`, `together/link.js` or `folder-note.js`; the share room started at once in the click). The ninth (a share stopped before the part arrives starts no room) is a guard that held already. With the change all 9 pass; review round 1 added two (a room part with another seam version, for the host and a guest; a copy that lands after sharing failed), 11 of 11; the GPT second look's fix added one (a share stopped before its part failed: the next click says to reload, failing first on the old adapter), 12 of 12; the last second look's fix added one (the pointer or the focus on Share to edit fetches the part), 13 of 13 (four of them changed with the next fix: the app's Undo is cleared only when the room starts; they failed on the previous head and pass now), and `kit specs` passes 477 of 477.
- The first load carries none of these parts: met. The startup files went from 16 files, 468,623 bytes, to 15 files, 428,101 bytes (−8.6 %); `tests/rare-parts.test.mjs` checks the four files are not among them. In headless Chrome, `smoke-rare-parts.mjs` saw no request for any of them while a new script was opened and typed in, at 1280 and 390 px.
- Each part loads on first use and works: met. `smoke-rare-parts.mjs` 92 ok, 0 fail (the pointer over Share to edit, Undo while the room's part is held and after that share is stopped, the Export menu, Export all, Share to edit with a guest, a held room, a held pack with a script switch, a folder saved while the pack is held, refused parts, a pack refused after the folder picker, 304 after a reload). The older suites on the same server, run again after each fix round (the last after dee5301): `smoke-csp` 51 ok (0 CSP violations), `smoke-saving` 73 ok, `smoke-broll-lazy` 91 ok (its 1280 px "another script" step, a click on "New script" in the script menu, timed out in 2 of 6 full-suite runs right after other suites; alone it passed 4 of 4 on this branch and 3 of 3 on `origin/dev`), `smoke-video-folder` 93 ok, `smoke-keep-all` 933 ok, `smoke-room` 27 ok, `smoke-relay` 42 ok.
- A plain error line on a load failure: met. With the requests refused, the share button, Export all, Save to video folder and a guest's Join each said to reload (`smoke-rare-parts.mjs`), with no page error.
- A folder saved while the pack loads holds the script as it was at the click (GPT second look, P2): met. With the copy taken out, `smoke-rare-parts.mjs` failed at both widths (`script.md` had "Hello there my friend." while `prompter.md` had "Typed later." too); with it, every file holds the text of the click.
- A share stopped before its part failed says so on the next click (GPT second look, P2): met. The new unit test failed on the old adapter (the label stayed "Share to edit") and passes now.

- A guest who joins before the host's room has started (second look in `kit pr`, P2): partly met. The room's part is now fetched as the pointer or the focus reaches Share to edit (unit test, failing on the previous head, and `smoke-rare-parts.mjs` at 1280 px), so the room starts about as soon after the copied link as when it loaded with the page. The rest is declined below.

- A pending share keeps the app's Undo when it stops or fails (second look in `kit pr`, P2): met. Four unit tests failed on the previous head (`sharing` was called at the click and at the stop) and pass now; `smoke-rare-parts.mjs` checks Ctrl+Z while the part is held, and after the stopped share, at both widths.

### Declined

- R2 (gap, now partly added): Undo while the room's part is held is checked in the browser since the last second look; opening another script then is unit-tested through the adapter's split (`active` for Undo, `sharing` for opening); a test gap.
- GPT second look (gap): a runtime check for an export pack with another seam version (`Fetch.fulfillRequest` with `SEAM = 2`). It throws into the same handler as a refused request, which is checked at both widths; a test gap.
- Second look in `kit pr` (P2 race, the part left): a guest who joins in the moment between the copied link and the host's room reaching the server is refused as "ended" (`worker/room.js:84`: a room with no note yet). That moment was there before this step on `origin/dev` too: the link is copied in the click, before the host's socket has connected and made the room. This step widened it by one file's download, which the fetch on hover, press or focus now takes away in practice; the link has to reach another person, who opens it and types a name, before a guest can join. Telling a room that waits for its host from an ended one, with a retry for guests, is a change to the room protocol and the Worker, outside this step.
- Second look in `kit pr` (gaps): an early guest with the host's part held, Undo while it is held, a linked list's snapshot while the pack is held, and an export pack with another seam version: test gaps (the paths are unit-tested or share a checked handler).
- R3 (nit): `const list` in `saveToFolder` shadows the outer `list`; kept, it reads as the B-roll module's list there.
- R4 (gaps and nit): tests for the hover fetch with no script open and for a part that fails during the hover (the click then says to reload at once, copying nothing, which is what a failed part should do); the 1280 px "Share to edit loads together/room.js" line now follows the hover fetch (390 px still checks the click starts it); a hover-time failure staying failed until a reload, like any failed load. Test gaps and a rare path.
